# FaceFrenzy

> FaceFrenzy is the #1 Omegle alternative — random live video chat with real humans worldwide. Pick countries, set your vibe, meet your people. No bots, no mockups, just real 1-on-1 and group video conversations.

FaceFrenzy is a free random video chat platform that connects you with real people for live 1-on-1 and group video conversations. It is designed as a modern, Gen-Z-focused alternative to Omegle and Chatroulette.

## Key Features

- **Real human matchmaking**: WebSocket-based matching connects you only with currently online, real participants — no bots, no blank screens, no mockups.
- **1-on-1 video chat (solo mode)**: Instant pairing with another real person for a private video conversation.
- **Group video chat (group mode)**: Dynamic tile layout for 3–4 person group conversations.
- **Blind mode (voice first)**: Voice-first matching where cameras reveal after 30 seconds — get to know someone before seeing them.
- **Country and region filtering**: Choose who you connect with by region.
- **Display names**: Pick your own display name; your matched partner sees it during the chat.
- **Skip and rematch**: Not feeling the vibe? Skip to instantly find a new match.
- **WebRTC peer-to-peer**: Video and audio go directly between participants for zero-lag, high-quality HD video (up to 1080p).
- **Sponsor placements**: Businesses and creators can pay to display their app, product, website, or social handle in sponsor boxes on the lobby.
- **Age-gated and 18+**: All users must confirm they are 18+ before entering.
- **Cross-device**: Works on desktop and mobile browsers with camera and microphone access.

## How It Works

1. Confirm you are 18+ and pick a display name.
2. Choose a mode: solo (1-on-1), group, or blind (voice first).
3. The match server finds another real, currently online participant.
4. A WebRTC peer-to-peer connection is established directly between you and your match — video and audio never pass through a server.
5. Chat, talk, and skip to find a new match anytime.

## Technology

- Frontend: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js WebSocket match server (Railway), Supabase (auth, profiles)
- Real-time video: WebRTC peer-to-peer
- Payments: Stripe for sponsor placements
- Deployed at https://www.facefrenzy.fun

## Pages

- [Home / Lobby](https://www.facefrenzy.fun/): Mode picker, webcam preview, sponsor boxes, and start button.
- [Match / Searching](https://www.facefrenzy.fun/match): Radar animation while the server finds a real match.
- [Chat Room](https://www.facefrenzy.fun/chat): Live 1-on-1 or group video chat with controls for skip, mute, and camera toggle.

## FAQ

**Is FaceFrenzy free?**
Yes, video chat is completely free. Sponsor placements are paid.

**Is FaceFrenzy like Omegle?**
Yes — FaceFrenzy is a modern alternative to Omegle with real-human-only matching, multiple chat modes, and HD video.

**Are the people real?**
Yes. FaceFrenzy only matches you with currently connected, real participants. There are no bots or mockups.

**Do I need to download an app?**
No. FaceFrenzy works directly in your browser on desktop and mobile.
